Name: NPC Voices -Gibberish speech
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[center][b][size=5]NPC Voices — Give the Valley a Voice[/size][/b][/center]
Gentle murmurs, vowel sounds, and short syllables make conversations more expressive while leaving each character’s words to your imagination. This is gibberish speech, not text-to-speech or full voice acting.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Individual NPC voices[/b] — distinct profiles for the Valley’s residents, ranging from bright and cheerful to deep, calm, or slightly rough.[/*]
[*][b]42 synthesized syllable variants per voice profile[/b] — six vowel sounds combined with soft beginnings resembling “m,” “n,” “b,” “d,” “w,” “y,” and “h.”[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue synchronization[/b] — syllables play as text appears. Skipping the text or reaching the end of a line stops the voice.[/*]
[*][b]Emotional variation[/b] — supported dialogue markers can influence pitch, pace, volume, and tone.[/*]
[*][b]Support for custom NPCs[/b] — characters without a dedicated profile automatically receive a consistent generated voice.[/*]
[*][b]Voice content packs[/b] — create character profiles, emotion variants, and custom WAV syllables without writing C#.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration[/b] — global settings, individual NPC pages, voice previews, and reset controls.[/*]
[/list][heading]Make It Your Own[/heading]
Choose a voice type and adjust its pitch, tone, volume, speaking pace, and syllable frequency. You can also disable voices for individual characters.
Synthesized samples are prepared in the background and cached in memory. During conversations, the mod selects from those prepared variants without immediately repeating the last syllable.
[b]No TTS, AI services, internet connection, or audio transmission over the network.[/b]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.3.2 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional, for convenient in-game configuration[/*]
[/list]
If you cannot hear any voices, check your sound effects volume and enable the game’s [b]Dialogue Typing Sound[/b] option.
